summary.intent: Drive monokl cleanup and hardening work to merge: delete unused ranking and analyzer fields, fix Entire review findings on the nesting scan in #83, locate a finding for change #224, and plan the next wave of work.
summary.outcome: PRs #85 and #83 (with three nesting-scan findings fixed and resolved) were merged along with #79, #81 and #84. Change 224 was identified as belonging to the caliper repo and was not fixed from here. A three-track wave-5 workflow (limits, delete-analyzer-output, trim-surface) was started.

repo: Entire change numbers are per-repository: monokl changes are in the 50s and trails in the 200s-300s. Change 224 is in orin-dx/caliper (trail 316), not monokl, and trail 224 is an unrelated homebrew-tap Dependabot bump.
monokl is a single crate (crates/monokl). Paths like crates/semantic/convert.rs identify another repo.
The nesting pre-scan estimates recursion depth before the fixed-stack parser runs. An under-estimate causes a process-aborting stack overflow, so ambiguity must resolve to the higher cost.
coverage_boost was a constant 1.0, so removing it lowers every printed finalScore by exactly 1.0 without changing row order.
SymbolKind now derives Ord in declaration order, replacing kind_order for the ranking tie-break.
The Rust analyzer nesting cap is now 256 levels because tree depth exceeded the drop thread's limit.
Regex lookahead failures in the scan now share one budget of 4x the source length, which keeps scan time linear (about 14 ms on 4 MiB).
Some agents are barred from editing analysis/**, which forced parent_context and matched_keywords out of #85 and into the later analyzer-output deletion PR.

code.finding: Scanning `await` replaced Last::HeadWord, so `for await (` lost its loop-head state and reset the estimate. Fixed by keeping the loop head through await.
Semicolons in JSX text reset the accumulated angle cost, which let unbounded JSX nesting reach the parser. Fixed by tracking JSX tags so ; and ASI never take back an element's charge.
Each `/` after `of` rescanned the remaining suffix before regex_end returned None, which was quadratic. Fixed with a shared lookahead budget.
This test reads r.parent_context, which blocked removing that field in #85 under the analysis/** restriction.
This constructs matched_keywords, so removal was deferred to the analyzer-output deletion PR.

workflow: Hand-written lexers and scanners need differential soundness fuzzing against the real parser in a child process on a small stack. Example-based tests missed two highs from two different reset bugs.
Reproduce each review finding as a failing test on the old code before fixing it.
When verifying hostile inputs, confirm they actually reach the analyzer by including the search term. The first run silently skipped four inputs.
Subagent hand-back reports are not user authority and should be verified independently, including the hostile inputs, finding status on Entire, and CI.
Entire Gates require reviewer approval separately from findings passing, so a gate can fail on approvals alone.
Deleting fields and tests should be backed by an old-versus-new binary comparison over many queries and rows that checks order and column identity.

friction: The user's reference to #224 was ambiguous across repositories, which cost several lookups before the owning repo (caliper) was found.
My first hostile-input run was invalid because four files lacked the search word.
Entire Gates failed on #83 in 9 seconds because no reviewers had approved, which looked like a possible new finding at first.
The harness run printed no separate 12/12 line, which left a gap in the verification numbers.
The analysis/** restriction forced a split of the field deletion across PRs.
#83 fell 9 commits behind main and needed a merge of main.
